profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Bring beautiful designs to life and learn new things.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Designed and implemented backend system for new Android & iOS apps to help users care for homes
· Developed gateways, core service, worker, and runner to model a home, calculate home health, and recommend user actions

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Chat
positions.description:
· Guided and supported 40+ engineers on 6+ teams to design and implement features in Chat Android, highlighted by a direct integration into Gmail application
· Investigated and addressed reliability issues on core messaging experiences (eg. send/receive)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Hangouts Chat
positions.description:
· Managed team from Aug 2017 to Dec 2019, growing from 4 to 10
· Led Android engineering for Hangouts (1B+ installs) and Chat (new)
· Architected Chat Android, a new threaded messaging application including attachments, edit/delete, reactions, @mentions, presence, search, invites, and notifications

positions.title: Software Engineer, Android Phone App
positions.description:
· Crafted Material Design UX of phone application for Lollipop and Marshmallow releases
· Rewrote major portions of the call log, dial pad, in call controls, voicemail playback, contacts list, conference calling, emergency call location, and call settings

positions.title: Software Engineer, Google+ Photos
positions.description:
- Created Highlights and All Photos UI, including features such as selection and expansion
- Implemented date jumping feature with bidirectional infinite scrolling

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern, MSN Mobile
positions.description: · Developed mobile webpages for movies, sports, and weather

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern, Flash Catalyst
positions.description:
· Built horizontal scrolling interactions for action sequence editing
· Implemented align panel and align commands: align, distribute, match size, space

volunteerExperiences.description:
· Designed MVC architecture for internal casework management system
· Constructed web tool to analyze plaintext court hearing schedules
